sourceNote: The A-pose rabbit mesh (assets/models/rabbit/README.md), with new quad faces on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist, so that the arms and the wrists do not twist. tools/blender/violin_arms.py makes these faces. The other faces and rabbit-apose.glb stay unchanged.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/violin_arms.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, as on the polar bear, because the seated bind of the app depends on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units, which spans the three rings of its joint in the bind. The app turns them from the joints of the pose (poseArm() of src/models/studio-rig.ts).

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within radius (units) of the head of an upper arm take the normals of the skin with no crease angle in the app (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), as on the fox and the cat. Thus the seam between the upper arm and the trunk shows no hard line.
rootNormals.armShareNote: A face of the radius stays in the rim only when the mean weight of its corners on the clavicle and the arm bones of its side is 0.3 or more (root_rim()), as on the hippo. Thus the faces of the upper chest and the back keep their facets.
rootNormals.elbowNote: The faces within 0.06 units of each elbow joint take the skin normals too, as on the fox. The bind bends each elbow, and the crease angle splits the normals of the inner elbows into hard lines.

name: Rabbit

app.note: The app puts the standing shoulder joints 0.8513179 m above the floor (ANIMALS of tools/studio-body.ts). The shoulder joints of the mesh are at 0.574 u after the leg factor, so the scale is 1.4831 m for each unit. The reach is 0.3647 m, and the violin is 0.83 of the violin of the app.

armFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the arm length, because the rig with arm segments does not stretch the arms. The arms of rabbit-arms.glb are 1.15 times longer than the source arms (step_shape() of tools/blender/violin_arms.py), and the arm joints are the joints of the longer arms, so the reach stays app.reach.
legFactorNote: The factor of the thigh and the shin. Each one stretches only between its joints, the foot keeps its size, and the body rises 0.105 units, so that the soles stay at y 0. The chair of the app fits the legs, so the soles stand on the floor.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The palm is the true palm of the source, in, down, and a little back, as the palm of the fox.

studio.trunkNote: The trunk of the seated bind sits upright (trunk_turn() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py): the pelvis turns back until the hip angle opens by open degrees, as seated string players sit tall. The shares fall from the spine1 to the head in equal steps, so that the head stays level. The value 0 keeps the trunk of the source.
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of the left arm turns 100 degrees about its bind forearm toward supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), and the forearm segments share the turn. The bind paw sets the zero of the paw twist, so the violin paw does not twist through 180 degrees. The right paw keeps the bind arms.
studio.note: The thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 8 degrees out, so that the hips are above the knees, and the shin is vertical, as the legs of the red fox (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 8 0, tools/mesh-rigs/fox.json). The bind arms are the bind arms of the studio rabbit, from tools/rig/studio-targets.ts.

sliver.note: The corners of each thin face share one set of weights, so that the face moves rigidly and does not turn over at a bent joint. A thin face has a corner angle below angle (degrees) and a longest edge below longest (units).

line.note: The middle corner of each long thin face (a corner angle above angle, in degrees) takes the mix of the weights of its two other corners by its place along their line, so that it does not lag behind the line when a joint bends.

weights.shoulderHeadNote: Below headFrom, the share of the head weight that goes to the neck grows from 0 at the smaller distance from the middle plane to all at the larger distance (units). Thus the turns of the head do not pull the top of each shoulder.
weights.fingersNote: The fingers keep this share of their bone heat weight, and the hand takes the rest, so that the curl of the fingers does not turn over a face between the hand and the fingers.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the haunch stays on the seat and the thigh turns onto it. This is the ramp of the fox, scaled by the thigh of the rabbit.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom, each vertex except the ears follows the head only. Each ear vertex goes to its ear bone with a ramp over the heights of earBase. The tail ball follows the tail only.

flip.note: The long edge of a face of the arms with a corner angle above angle (degrees) flips to the corner of the face on its other side, when the two faces lie almost on one plane and the flip moves the surface by at most move (units). The angle 180 turns the flips off.

refine.ringsNote: No ring: the quad tube of each arm of rabbit-arms.glb has 3 rings at each elbow and at each wrist.

check.note: pnpm rig-mesh --check lists the thin faces of the seated bind mesh near a joint of the arms or the legs as candidates for a ring (refine.rings).

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the texture at a grid of samples. A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples are below dark. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a face in the nose box near the nose color is the nose. A palette of palette colors (k-means in Oklab) keeps the colors few.

eyeShell.note: Each eye shell is a fan from the middle of the dark faces of the eye to at most points points of their edge, lifted along the normal of the eye. pnpm studio-body drops the fan, and the app puts its pea eye there (design 4.5). The faces of the old eye take the main color of the ring around it.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat. Its front edge ends where the sloped thighs leave the seat top at the haunch. The chair of the app grows back until its back posts keep 1 cm behind the trunk (backRoom of ANIMALS of tools/studio-body.ts).

crease.note: The seated bind is smoothed across the crease where the belly meets the top of each thigh (crease_relax() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). Each vertex near the seam moves share of the way to the middle of its neighbors in rounds rounds, with a weight that falls from the seam out.

sit.note: The underside of the haunch goes down onto the seat in the seated bind, with the rule of the fox (sit of tools/mesh-rigs/fox.json). The drop fades over the last 0.02 units of the haunch, where the haunch meets the tail ball, so that no face between them turns over.
